leadText:
Peaches (Japanese: モモ Momo) is a character who appeared in Jigglypuff's Song, the eighth episode of the POKÉTOON animated shorts.

Peaches was a little girl who met and quickly formed a bond with a . One day, when they met Alba and her Jigglypuff, Peaches was confronted about the reasons her Jigglypuff didn't sing. After discussing their feelings, Peaches decided to support Jigglypuff and, when confronted by Alba again, Jigglypuff finally decided to sing. The melody created by Peaches's Jigglypuff finally reached the heart of its Trainer who realized how much Jigglypuff loved her.

Over time, Jigglypuff's music made Alba and Peaches become friends, but they didn't realize that Jigglypuff also had the power to put the girls to .
